name: @pipeworx/mcp-geohash

tools.name: encode_geohash
tools.description: Encode a latitude/longitude to a geohash string (keyless, offline). `precision` = number of characters (1-12, default 9; more chars = smaller cell).

tools.name: decode_geohash
tools.description: Decode a geohash to its center coordinate and bounding box (SW/NE corners). Keyless, offline.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-geohash forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the geohash pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
